why: Issue #630. The earned/locked word is screen-reader-only again, as #629 left it. A screen reader still hears 'Earned', but on screen the only difference between an earned and a locked achievement is `opacity: 0.45` against 1 plus a gold border, which is a dimming and a hue that forced colours and a greyscale screenshot both flatten. Killed by the visible-word case.
killedBy: HUD achievement list (issue #629) shows earned or locked as a visible word, not only a dimming and a border hue (issue #630)
